purpose: Measure Design B support, second-level player and time splits, and same-metric ring16 comparators without selecting a design or making a feasibility decision.

player_game_distribution.unit: source-domain player key incidence in the measured subset

support_measurement.outcome_definition: F0-D0 outcome_analysis_eligible only; never inferred from recorded result
support_measurement.phase_definition: repository get_game_phase on the exact predecessor board; place, move, and fly are reported as placement, movement, and flying

b1_player_resplit.source_definition: all post-cut games whose two player keys are absent from every behavior game before the source cut
b1_player_resplit.zero_cut_measurement: connected components of the induced player graph
b1_player_resplit.method: weighted Louvain initialization followed by exact-size Kernighan-Lin edge-cut minimization; game count is the edge weight
b1_player_resplit.selection_rule_for_measurement_only: minimum discarded cross-partition games, then lexicographically smallest membership SHA-256

b2_time_resplit.base_test_pool_definition: the 4577 games after the base cut whose two players are absent before the base cut
b2_time_resplit.segment_total_definition: games from the base test pool whose date falls in the segment
b2_time_resplit.strong_segment_definition: segment games whose two player keys are absent from every behavior game before that segment start

ring16_comparison.state_identity: repository ring16: D4 x abstract inner/outer-ring swap over the pre-decision NMM FEN
ring16_comparison.primary_overlap_metric: for each partition, decisions whose ring16 orbit occurs in at least one other partition divided by all decisions in that partition
design_b_profiles: coarse March train versus strong post-cut pool

design_c_comparator.method: reuse the sealed previous result without recomputation

random_baseline.selection_method: sort by SHA-256(namespace, seed, session_id), take left then right

ring16_comparison.interpretation_rule: report B, prior C, and random baseline together; make no design judgment in this round

raw_record_access.reason: F0-D0 retains per-game move counts but not exact per-ply phase or predecessor ring16 state
raw_record_access.allowed_files: only F0-D0 manifest-bound behavior-eligible raw games required by a frozen phase or ring16 profile
raw_record_access.verification: verify each path, size, SHA-256, session id, move count, strict metadata, legal move, notation, and strict terminal eligibility
